A directory page is mostly links, and the part worth reading is usually the short piece of writing underneath it. This paragraph is that piece, and it is the one an extractor should pick.

The test is whether link density beats raw length. The list above has more characters in it than this does, but nearly all of them sit inside anchors, so it should lose to the prose that nobody can click.

Everything here is deliberately plain so that the scoring, and not the wording, is what decides which block wins.
